name: Zacess Deep Contrast Dark
description: White on black with deep, fully saturated colours, yellow focus outlines and cyan frames, for low vision.
toml:
# the Zacess Deep Contrast Dark theme as a profile, one of the ten starter profiles
# colours from the Zacess themes palette 0.12.1

spec_version = 1
name = "Zacess Deep Contrast Dark"
id = "zacess-deep-contrast-dark"
description = "White on black with deep, fully saturated colours, yellow focus outlines and cyan frames, for low vision."
appearance = "dark"

[needs]
reduce_motion = true
cursor_size = "standard"
focus_ring_width_px = 2

[needs.contrast]
text = 7.0
non_text = 3.0
overlay = 4.5
terminal = 7.0
terminal_dim = 4.5
highlight_distance = 0.08
colour_vision_distance = 0.04
tone_difference = 0.05

[needs.font]
family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"
fallback = "monospace"
size_pt = 14

[palette]
background = "#000000"
foreground = "#ffffff"
surface = "#000000"
surface_alt = "#0a0a0a"
muted = "#b3b3b3"
border = "#00ffff"
accent = "#00ffff"
accent_foreground = "#000000"
link = "#1db4ff"
focus_ring = "#ffff00"
cursor = "#ffff00"
cursor_text = "#000000"
selection_background = "#ff70ff"
selection_foreground = "#000000"
selection_soft = "#720072"
line_highlight = "#262626"
error = "#fe8167"
warning = "#ffd370"
info = "#59a4f9"

[palette.syntax]
keyword = "#67aeff"
control = "#ffabfd"
function = "#ffdf5a"
type = "#00ebb1"
variable = "#ffffff"
parameter = "#ffffff"
property = "#c195ff"
string = "#ffaa7c"
number = "#e19e00"
comment = "#00c600"
operator = "#ffffff"
tag = "#67aeff"
attribute = "#c195ff"
regex = "#ff80c5"
invalid = "#fd8b78"
added = "#00f000"
removed = "#ffaa7c"
changed = "#67aeff"

[palette.terminal]
ansi = [
    "#000000", "#ff5f5f", "#00cd00", "#cdcd00",
    "#8888ff", "#ff2aff", "#00cdcd", "#e5e5e5",
    "#b8b8b8", "#ff9e9e", "#00ff00", "#ffff00",
    "#b0b0ff", "#ff8fff", "#00ffff", "#ffffff",
]
background_slots = [0]

check.output:
pass profiles/zacess-deep-contrast-dark.toml (Zacess Deep Contrast Dark)
     224 pairs against text 7:1, non-text 3:1, overlay 4.5:1, terminal 7:1 and dim terminal 4.5:1, with paired colours 0.05 apart in tone and 0.04 under colour vision deficiencies
     tightest terminal.ansi[4] #8888ff on background #000000: 7.01:1
